social_circle.name: Elena Fernandez

demographics.education: some college or vocational medical-office training

background.how_they_met: Elena is Sonia and Manuel's younger adult child, raised by them in Houston.
background.why_close: They are emotionally close, live in the same city, share family meals, discuss health care and racial justice issues, and Elena texts Sonia almost every day.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts frequently in a mix of English and Spanish, usually quick practical updates with occasional longer emotional messages. More direct and expressive than Sonia.

shared_activities: Sunday family meals when Sonia cooks mole or caldo
holiday gatherings for Christmas, Easter, Mother's Day, and Dia de los Muertos
conversations about racism, health care, and family stress
recent_text_topics: Checking whether Sonia is cooking on Sunday and whether she should bring anything.
Talking about stressful patient calls at Elena's medical office and Sonia reminding her to rest.
Discussing racism and health care language after news or workplace incidents.
Sharing family logistics for holidays, birthdays, and possible visits.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Elena is Sonia's 29-year-old daughter who lives in Houston near the Heights, works in a medical office, comes by often on Sundays, and 'texts almost every day.' Q26 and Q29 say Sonia talks with Elena about racism and racial justice. Q46 says Elena gets stressed from patient calls at work.

social_circle.name: Manuel Fernandez

demographics.education: high school diploma with trade and HVAC training

background.how_they_met: Manuel and Sonia married in their mid-twenties and built their household and family life together in Houston.
background.why_close: They have been married 31 years, live together, share household expenses, errands, dinners, health concerns, retirement planning, and family routines.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly and practically, often about errands, bills, appointments, traffic, or dinner. Uses short sentences and gentle teasing rather than long emotional messages.

recent_text_topics: Coordinating grocery runs, Costco stock-up trips, and Saturday errands.
Updates about his truck repair, back pain, cholesterol, and appointments Sonia puts on the calendar.
Quick messages about dinner timing, Astros games, and whether Elena or Daniel's family is coming over.
Retirement and household finance reminders, especially car loan payoff and health insurance planning.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Sonia is married to Manuel Fernandez, they have been married 31 years, eat dinner together most nights, do Saturday errands, and watch games. Q11 says they divide chores. Q35 mentions Manuel's cholesterol and back pain. Q55 and Q74 say they share expenses and income.

Coordinating visits from Katy, including birthdays and Astros-game get-togethers.

Talking about balancing childcare, bills, and family stress.
